control_failures.control_label: parking, chocking and restraint of equipment
application of positive isolation devices and personal locks

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: regulator directive concerning energy isolation at ML-3202

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was medical treatment injury, with 1 person injured.

defences.finding: Control PARK_UP_AND_RESTRAINT: the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

Control POSITIVE_ISOLATION_APPLICATION: the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks was in place but did not perform, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment on ML-3202 and M-3202 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
Restore the application of positive isolation devices and personal locks on ML-3202 and M-3202 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in planning and permitting an isolation, specifically authorising a group isolation. ML-3202 (grinding mills) is in service for two-line ball milling. The task proceeded during a planned shutdown while the parking, chocking and restraint of equipment was in place but did not perform. The electrical energy involved is held as HV switchgear, and the recorded presentation was shock, arc flash, unplanned energisation.
response.summary: On 21 January 2020 a regulatory notice was issued concerning ML-3202 and M-3202 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility following a planned shutdown.
